factors.value_notes: A 2025 juvenile growth experiment found 22–26 °C optimal for on-growing juveniles; FishBase reports a model-derived estimate of 16.9–29 °C (mean 27.1 °C; 3,486 cells). Neither establishes adult wild SST preference. The configured 18–30 °C / 22–28 °C bands are partially supported with life-stage/model caveats.
